chunks.terms: microsoft m365 defender sentinel business premium why need mdr
chunks.simple: Microsoft Defender provides detection technology. The approved material describes MDR as the additional 24/7 human investigation and response layer, including containment actions for confirmed incidents.
chunks.technical: The approved Microsoft 365 material describes a Defender/Sentinel-native monitoring model with human investigation and containment for confirmed incidents.

chunks.terms: 2am overnight weekend out hours attack alert triage containment forensic incident ransomware
chunks.simple: The approved MDR material gives an overnight sequence: a critical alert is picked up by a human analyst, investigated, contained when confirmed, followed through with forensic investigation, and documented in an incident report.
chunks.technical: The published sequence describes EDR detection, analyst triage, ATT&CK correlation, containment after confirmation, forensic mapping of the attack chain, and an incident report.

chunks.simple: The approved material publishes MDR from £900 per month. It says pricing varies with endpoints or users, log sources and service tier, with fixed monthly pricing after scoping and incident response included.
chunks.technical: The public MDR material states an entry price of £900/month, with scope driven by endpoints/users, log sources and service tier. Full incident response is described as included.

chunks.terms: managed soc security operations centre outsourced analysts monitor investigate contain siem plain english
chunks.simple: A managed SOC is essentially an outsourced security team watching for threats around the clock. The approved material describes external analysts monitoring, investigating and containing threats as a service.
chunks.technical: The approved guide describes outsourced 24/7 security operations combining platform tooling with analysts who correlate telemetry, triage alerts, hunt for threats and support incident response.

chunks.simple: The approved MDR material describes the service as vendor-agnostic and able to integrate with existing security tooling rather than requiring every customer to replace its stack.
chunks.technical: The MDR material describes correlation across endpoint, network, identity and cloud telemetry and vendor-agnostic integration with common EDR tooling.
